Senses.Explanation: Unable to tell servant from master is a paired idiom for failing to distinguish unequal roles or kinds. Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB370.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Nouyun (耨雲禪師語錄): Nouyun Zhenshi opens a New Year hall address by saying that every year, month, day, and hour is good.

Senses.Explanation: Every year is a good year is a calendrical formula paired with every day being a good day, then challenged, answered, and mocked in New Year interviews. The unnamed questioner presents the year-and-day pair to Chushi Fanqi, who answers with the image of a blind old woman blowing a fire. Another New Year exchange asks why there is no teaching if every year and day is good; the quoted respondent answers that Zhang drinks while Li gets drunk. Huqiu Shaolong expands the formula through every month, day, and hour after asking whether the assembly has entered the gateless gate. Recurrence therefore does not make it bland seasonal optimism: the saying remains a claim that masters publicly test.

Senses.Note: The literal seasonal setting and inherited question formula are deployments of the same phrase.

Senses.Explanation: To bathe the Buddha image is the Buddha-birthday rite named by formal occasion labels and by Huanglong Huinan's statement that monasteries are bathing the Buddha. The saved headings attach that rite to addresses by Foyan Qingyuan, Huguo Cian Jingyuan, Liao'an Qingyu, and others, while Huanglong recounts the ladle-and-washing exchange. The concrete rite remains present, so these records do not justify replacing it with 'purify the mind.'

Senses.Note: The phrase is a deliberate postponement in public exchange; it does not promise that instruction was literally delivered the following day.

Senses.Explanation: The rest is deferred until tomorrow cuts off an exchange by postponing what would follow. Chushi Fanqi answers a scripture lecturer’s failed response by saying the text below is long and deferred until tomorrow. Muzhou Daoming uses the same formula after giving the first of three sections. Shenfeng Xian casts down the fly-whisk, says that the text below is still long and deferred until tomorrow, and leaves the seat.
